entities.summary: Jamil Mahammad oglu Ahmadov was an Azerbaijani Red Army lieutenant who served as platoon commander of the 168th Guards Rifle Regiment of the 55th Guards Rifle Division. He was awarded the Order of the Red Star following the battle of Ukraine, and received the Hero of the Soviet Union posthumously on 24 March 1945 for his actions in Operation Bagration. Ahmadov reportedly continued to command his platoon while wounded and died of his wounds.
